content: We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see signals for CH3 (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see CH3 carbon signals (around 10-30 ppm). We need to count distinct methyl groups. Use proton NMR tool. Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
